title: Japanese Wholesome Rice Bowl
description: A simple and nutritious Japanese-inspired rice bowl filled with grilled chicken, vegetables, and a savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and green beans

instructions: Cook the Japanese rice according to package instructions.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and sesame oil. Grill for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil for the dressing.
In a separate pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom, followed by sliced grilled chicken, vegetables, and a drizzle of dressing.
Garnish with sesame seeds, green onions, and pickled ginger.
